freeze: Immobilizes an enemy piece (not the king) for {dur}. A frozen piece cannot move and does not give check.
shield: One of your pieces (not the king) cannot be captured for {dur}.
cloak: Hides one of your pieces (not the king) from your opponent for {dur}.
morph_own: Turns one of your pieces (not the king) into {into} for {dur}, then it returns to its shape.
morph_enemy: Turns an enemy piece (not the king) into {into} for {dur}, then it returns to its shape.
promote: One of your pieces (neither the king nor a queen) becomes a queen for good.
remove: Removes an enemy piece from the board: {kinds}.
convert: An enemy piece (not the king) that attacks none of yours switches to your side for good.
teleport: Moves one of your pieces (not the king) to any empty square, ignoring obstacles.
duplicate: Copies one of your pieces (not the king) onto a neighboring empty square.
swap_own: Swaps the places of two of your pieces.
swap_any: Swaps the places of two pieces, whichever side they belong to (not the kings).
spawn: Summons a temporary piece ({kinds}) on a free square of ranks 3 to 6, for {dur}.
revive: Brings back one of your captured pieces ({kinds}) to the board, on its original square or the nearest one.
truce: Armistice: for {dur}, nothing attacks anything. No captures, no check.
mirror: The two sides swap armies: each player inherits the other's pieces, on the mirrored squares.
fog: Fog: for {dur}, each player only sees the enemy pieces within two squares of their own.
silence: Your opponent cannot use any power for {dur}.
ambush: Domain Expansion: for {dur}, the first time your opponent puts your king in check, bishops burst out and capture the pieces attacking it.
zone_own_half: Only in your half of the board.
zone_enemy_half: Only in your opponent's half of the board.
zone_center: Only in the center of the board (files c to f, ranks 3 to 6).
zone_wings: Only on the wings (files a, b, g and h).
zone_rim: Only on the edge of the board.
cond_behind: Usable only if you have less material than your opponent.
cond_ahead: Usable only if you have more material than your opponent.
cond_early: Usable only before each player's 10th move.
cond_late: Usable only from each player's 20th move.
cond_no_queen: Usable only if you no longer have a queen.
cond_wounded: Usable only if you have lost at least three pieces.
cons_only_in_check: Usable only while your king is in check.
cons_forbid_mate: Refused if it would checkmate your opponent.
cons_forbid_check: Refused if it would leave a king in check.
free: Does not use up your turn.
